1. (Currently amended) Claim 281:

A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and at least two adhesive layers, the tool comprising:
first and second layers;
a first adhesive layer configured to be cured on the first layer;
a second adhesive layer configured to be cured on the second layer;
the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer configured to be cured to each other;
the tool has a circular shape and includes a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers;
a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer; and
__an additional adhesive layer distinct from the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer, wherein the additional adhesive layer is positioned between at least one of the first and second layers and the medial section__.

2. (Currently amended) Claim 282:

The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises __a metal material different from the material composition of the first and second layers__.

3. (Currently amended) Claim 283:

The tool of claim 282, wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure __having a density less than the first and second layers__.

4. (Currently amended) Claim 284:

The tool of claim 282, wherein the medial section is a composite material __comprising the metal combined with a reinforcing material__.

5. (Currently amended) Claim 285:

The tool of claim 281, further comprising:
a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers;
wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section;
wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring; and
wherein the weld ring is continuous __and extends radially outward from the medial section__.

6. (Currently amended) Claim 286:

The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section __by a bonding process distinct from the curing of the adhesive layers__.

7. (Currently amended) Claim 287:

The tool of claim 285, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring __using a welding process that creates a permanent joint__.

8. (Currently amended) Claim 288:

The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is continuous __and has a uniform cross-sectional profile__.

9. (Original) Claim 289:

Claims 289 and 295 are rejected under pre-AIA 35 U.S.C. 103(a) as being unpatentable over Hallez as applied to claims 285 and 293 above, and further in view of Okinaga (US 5040341).

10. (Currently amended) Claim 290:

The tool of claim 285, further comprising:
an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring;
wherein the inner ring includes a central opening for accommodating a drive shaft; and
__wherein the inner ring is formed from a material selected to provide structural support independent of the weld ring__.

11. (Currently amended) Claim 291:

The tool of claim 290, wherein the inner ring includes __a__ central opening __having a diameter sized to accommodate a standard drive shaft__.

12. (Currently amended) Claim 293:

The tool of claim 281, further comprising:
a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring;
wherein the weld ring is continuous; and
__wherein the weld ring provides structural support to the cutting segments independent of direct bonding to the medial section__.

13. (Currently amended) Claim 294:

The tool of claim 293, wherein the weld ring is continuous __and maintains structural integrity during rotation of the tool__.
